exec: pm.test("Has id and same RUC", () => { pm.expect(c.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(c.ruc).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("ruc")); });

pm.test("Problem detail names the ruc field", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Content-Type")).to.include("application/problem+json"); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Bad Request"); pm.expect(body.detail).to.be.a("string").that.is.not.empty; pm.expect(body.errors).to.have.property("ruc"); });

pm.test("Problem detail", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(409); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Conflict"); pm.expect(body.detail).to.include("already exists"); });

pm.test("Every name contains the search", () => { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("customerId")); const list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.some(c => c.id === id)).to.eql(true); list.forEach(c => pm.expect(c.businessName.toLowerCase()).to.include("soporte andino")); });

pm.test("Problem detail", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Not Found"); pm.expect(body.detail).to.be.a("string").that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test("Linked to the plan and dated", () => { pm.expect(t.planId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("planId"))); pm.expect(t.updatedAt).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Stores the document head", () => pm.expect(t.content).to.include("# CONTRATO DE PRESTACIÓN DE SERVICIOS DE SOPORTE"));

pm.test("Only that plan", () => { const pid = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("planId")); const list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list).to.not.be.empty; list.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.planId).to.eql(pid)); });
pm.test("Starts GENERATED without validity", () => { pm.expect(k.status).to.eql("GENERATED"); pm.expect(k.validity).to.be.null; });

pm.test("Problem detail", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Not Found"); pm.expect(body.detail).to.be.a("string").that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test("All GENERATED", () => { const list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list).to.not.be.empty; list.forEach(k => pm.expect(k.status).to.eql("GENERATED")); });
pm.test("Keeps the same RUC", () => { const c = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.businessName).to.eql("Soporte Andino Actualizado SAC"); pm.expect(c.ruc).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("ruc")); });

exec: pm.test("Keeps the document around the new clause", () => { const t = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(t.content).to.include("# CONTRATO DE PRESTACIÓN DE SERVICIOS DE SOPORTE"); pm.expect(t.content).to.include("soporte técnico prioritario"); pm.expect(t.content).to.include("## 3) Condiciones económicas y forma de pago."); });

pm.test("Unsigned contract is not active", () => { const id = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("contractId")); const list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.find(k => k.id === id)).to.eql(undefined); list.forEach(k => pm.expect(k.validity).to.eql("ACTIVE")); });
pm.test("Recalculates amount and end date", () => { pm.expect(Number(k.amount)).to.eql(400); pm.expect(k.endDate).to.eql("2027-12-01"); });

pm.test("Status 415", () => pm.response.to.have.status(415));
pm.test("Problem detail", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql(415); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Unsupported Media Type"); });
